description: Item write-mod's deliverable (writing a Python source module inside parallel-development) contradicts item scope-decl's declared out-of-scope boundary ('this skill does not implement code ... Out-of-scope: writing source modules'). A plan-model cannot both forbid code implementation and contain an item that ships a source module.
precision_rule: A correct review cites BOTH the scope boundary (scope-decl.scope) and the violating deliverable (write-mod.scope) with quotes. A review that flags write-mod as 'over-engineering' or scope-decl as 'gap' misses the contradiction — wrong defect, not precise.
